courses.overview: 由郵件身份、網域對齊與隔離判讀連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect mail identity, domain alignment and quarantine analysis to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 網域名稱系統架構
related.why: 可移植「Envelope 與 From」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from envelope and from; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「Envelope 與 From」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from envelope and from; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理郵件身份、網域對齊與隔離判讀；「網域名稱系統架構」主要處理分散式命名、快取一致性與驗證鏈，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes mail identity, domain alignment and quarantine analysis; Domain-name-system architecture emphasizes distributed naming, cache consistency and validation chains. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「安全電子郵件閘道」與「網域名稱系統架構」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「Canonicalization」的對照方法至「快取 TTL」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Secure email gateways and Domain-name-system architecture flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from canonicalization to cache ttl, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 安全網頁應用程式防護
related.why: 可移植「Envelope 與 From」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from envelope and from; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「Envelope 與 From」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from envelope and from; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理郵件身份、網域對齊與隔離判讀；「安全網頁應用程式防護」主要處理應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes mail identity, domain alignment and quarantine analysis; Web-application protection systems emphasizes application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「安全電子郵件閘道」與「安全網頁應用程式防護」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「Canonicalization」的對照方法至「規則範圍」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Secure email gateways and Web-application protection systems flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from canonicalization to rule scopes, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
